data.narrative:
Breaker Industries is a Seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $6M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic, representing a mix of Seed and Series A stage companies in the same sector.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-Progression, anchoring to the $6M raised as a proxy for current value, applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, yielding $15M. Peer-Median analysis across the 5 most directly comparable firms (Stark Defence at $4.0B, UFORCE at $1.0B, Castelion at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, and NODA AI at $125M) produces a median of $1.0B, with a range of $125M to $4.0B. The wide dispersion reflects variance in stage mix and company maturity within the Defense & Security sector.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $13M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $508M. The significant spread between methods reflects the high heterogeneity in Defense & Security valuations and stage progression assumptions. Key uncertainties include the applicability of the peer median given Breaker's early stage relative to most comparables, and the appropriateness of the 2.5x multiplier for this particular sector and founding team profile.
